answer: Call it a succession bond. A fresh address carries zero emission weight until it has answered thirty consecutive epochs. The only thread out is a bond from an incumbent, who burns their streak to hand it over. The handover keeps a fifth and is spent on receipt, so one senior account seeds exactly one heir. If a cluster claims that bond twice or votes in lockstep, the weight is voided. A thousand clones need a thousand incumbents; at 250,000 POA each, 250 million locked, paid to people who worked thirty epochs first. A willow in a zephyr sways, but each cutting still strikes its own root.
